title: Impact of oxygen deficiencies on magnetic properties of La0.725□0.275MnO3−δ compounds
content:
RSC Adv., 2026, 16,20194-20205
DOI: 10.1039/D5RA07059G, Paper

W. Ben Jdidia, H. Gharsallah, M. Smari, M. Bejar, E. K. Hlil, E. Dhahri
A discrepancy between the experimental and predicted magnetization saturation values was discovered from the hysteresis loops. An antiferromagnetic component for samples with δ = 0.15 and 0.35 is cited as an explanation for this disparity.
